displayName: Activation & Onboarding — Get to First Value Fast
description: Activate when: signups don't turn into active/paying users; 'people sign up but don't stick', designing onboarding, improving activation; aha moment, time-to-value. Do NOT activate when: the problem is acquisition (no signups) or long-term retention of already-activated users (different lever). More: deciqai.com/c/activation-onboarding-playbook
